scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The person driving the vehicle that is being parked, stopped or left standing.
To park a vehicle with its wheels parallel and next to the curb or side of the road.
Stopping by the side of the road for a short time, for example to check something outside the vehicle or to look for directions on a map.
A permit issued to a person with a disability that entitles the vehicle in which the named person is travelling to park in designated disabled parking, standing and stopping areas.
Opening the driver's door with the right hand, which forces a shoulder check at the same time.
A painted box on the road at an intersection, typically with a white bicycle symbol inside, that helps prevent collisions between motorists and bicycles.
A high-speed, multi-lane road, also called an expressway, where traffic in each direction is separated and ramps let vehicles enter and exit.

rules.title: Obey stopping, standing and parking signs
rules.when: signs say the DRIVER may not stop, or limit stopping, standing or parking
rules.action: obey those signs
rules.statement: WHEN signs say the DRIVER may not stop, or limit stopping, standing or parking, the DRIVER MUST obey those signs.
rules.note: The handbook adds that not all parking by-laws are posted on signs, so a missing sign does not mean parking is allowed.

rules.title: Secure the vehicle after parking
rules.when: the DRIVER has parked the vehicle
rules.action: turn off the ignition and the lights, remove the key and lock the door
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has parked the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST turn off the ignition and the lights, remove the key and lock the door.
rules.note: Reason given: to deter theft. Repeated in the parallel parking and hill parking steps.

rules.title: Do not leave children or animals in a parked vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER has parked the vehicle
rules.action: leave children or animals in the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has parked the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave children or animals in the vehicle.

rules.title: Turn off the engine when parked over 10 seconds
rules.when: the vehicle is parked for more than 10 seconds
rules.action: turn off the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked for more than 10 seconds, the DRIVER SHOULD turn off the vehicle.
rules.note: Worded as a command, but given in a list the handbook calls suggestions for driving efficiently (16.5), so recorded as ADVICE.

rules.title: Park completely off the road to watch an animal
rules.when: the DRIVER wishes to watch an animal on or near the road
rules.action: first find a safe place to pull completely off the road and park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER wishes to watch an animal on or near the road, the DRIVER MUST first find a safe place to pull completely off the road and park.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria for a safe place given

rules.title: Do not park on the shoulder to watch an animal
rules.when: the DRIVER stops to watch an animal on or near the road
rules.action: park on the shoulder of the road
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER stops to watch an animal on or near the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT park on the shoulder of the road.
rules.note: Reason given: other drivers may be distracted by the animal and hit the parked vehicle.

rules.title: Pull off and park when drowsy
rules.when: the DRIVER has one of the warning signs of serious drowsiness
rules.action: pull off the road and park the vehicle in a safe, secure place
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has one of the warning signs of serious drowsiness, the DRIVER MUST pull off the road and park the vehicle in a safe, secure place.

vague_terms.explanation: no criteria given beyond the suggestion of well-lit rest stops or truck stops

rules.note: The eight warning signs are listed in 13.28-13.35. The handbook suggests well-lit rest stops or truck stops on busy roads, locking the doors and taking a nap.

rules.title: Never park on the travelled part of a road
rules.when: the DRIVER parks
rules.action: park on the travelled part of a road
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER parks, the DRIVER MUST NOT park on the travelled part of a road.

rules.title: Stop on the shoulder
rules.when: the DRIVER must stop for some reason
rules.action: drive off the road onto the shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must stop for some reason, the DRIVER MUST drive off the road onto the shoulder.

rules.title: No parking without a clear view
rules.when: the DRIVER is on a curve OR on a hill OR anywhere the DRIVER does not have a clear view for at least 125 metres in both directions
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is on a curve OR on a hill OR anywhere the DRIVER does not have a clear view for at least 125 metres in both directions, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Do not block vehicles, sidewalks, crossings or entrances
rules.when: parking would block a vehicle already parked OR a sidewalk OR a crosswalk OR a pedestrian crossing OR a road entrance
rules.action: park there
rules.statement: WHEN parking would block a vehicle already parked OR a sidewalk OR a crosswalk OR a pedestrian crossing OR a road entrance, the DRIVER MUST NOT park there.

rules.title: Fire hydrant: 3 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 3 metres of a fire hydrant
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 3 metres of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Bridge: 100 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is on a bridge OR within 100 metres of a bridge
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is on a bridge OR within 100 metres of a bridge, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Public entrances: 6 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 6 metres of a public entrance to a hotel, theatre or public hall AND that building is open to the public
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 6 metres of a public entrance to a hotel, theatre or public hall AND that building is open to the public, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Intersection: 9 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 9 metres of an intersection
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 9 metres of an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.
rules.note: A larger distance applies to intersections controlled by traffic lights (PARK-LOC-09).

rules.title: Signalized intersection: 15 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 15 metres of an intersection controlled by traffic lights
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 15 metres of an intersection controlled by traffic lights, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Level railway crossing: 15 metres
rules.when: the DRIVER is within 15 metres of the nearest rail of a level railway crossing
rules.action: park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is within 15 metres of the nearest rail of a level railway crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT park.

rules.title: Do not obstruct traffic or snow clearing
rules.when: parking would get in the way of traffic OR of snow clearing
rules.action: park there
rules.statement: WHEN parking would get in the way of traffic OR of snow clearing, the DRIVER MUST NOT park there.

vague_terms.term: get in the way of traffic

rules.title: Avoid stopping on railway tracks
rules.when: the DRIVER is crossing railway tracks
rules.action: stop in the middle of the tracks
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is crossing railway tracks, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT stop in the middle of the tracks.
rules.note: The handbook adds that in heavy traffic the driver should make sure there is enough room to cross the tracks completely before beginning.

rules.title: Do not stop in a bike box
rules.when: the DRIVER stops for a traffic signal at an intersection with a BIKE BOX
rules.action: stop in the BIKE BOX
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER stops for a traffic signal at an intersection with a BIKE BOX, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop in the BIKE BOX.
rules.note: The same block requires the driver to stop behind the bike box. It points to Diagram 2-13, which is not given.

rules.title: Open a door only when safe
rules.when: the vehicle is parked
rules.action: open a door of the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER has first made sure that opening it will not endanger any other person or vehicle or interfere with traffic
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked, the DRIVER MUST NOT open a door of the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER has first made sure that opening it will not endanger any other person or vehicle or interfere with traffic.
rules.penalty: Three demerit points for improper opening of a vehicle door.
rules.note: Penalty taken from the table of offences (22.133).

rules.title: Use the Dutch reach
rules.when: the DRIVER opens the driver's door of a parked vehicle
rules.action: use the DUTCH REACH
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER opens the driver's door of a parked vehicle, the DRIVER SHOULD use the DUTCH REACH.
rules.note: Described as 'generally, a good practice'.

rules.title: Check traffic before opening the door
rules.when: the DRIVER has parked the vehicle AND is about to open the door
rules.action: check traffic before opening the door
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has parked the vehicle AND is about to open the door, the DRIVER MUST check traffic before opening the door.
rules.note: Stated in the parallel parking and hill parking steps.

rules.title: Watch for cyclists before opening a door
rules.when: the vehicle is parked on the side of the roadway AND the DRIVER is about to open a door
rules.action: look behind, check the mirrors and blind spots for a passing cyclist, and take extra precautions to avoid opening the door in the path of cyclists
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked on the side of the roadway AND the DRIVER is about to open a door, the DRIVER MUST look behind, check the mirrors and blind spots for a passing cyclist, and take extra precautions to avoid opening the door in the path of cyclists.
rules.note: Combined from two pages. Reason given: cyclists often ride close to parked cars. 11.10 points to Diagram 2-50, which is not given.

rules.title: Keep a traffic-side door open only briefly
rules.when: the DRIVER must open a door of a parked vehicle next to traffic
rules.action: keep it open only long enough to load or unload passengers
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must open a door of a parked vehicle next to traffic, the DRIVER MUST keep it open only long enough to load or unload passengers.

rules.title: Accessible parking spaces need a permit
rules.when: a parking space is designated for people with disabilities
rules.action: park in it
rules.unless: an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT belonging to the DRIVER or one of the DRIVER's passengers is displayed in the windshield of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a parking space is designated for people with disabilities, the DRIVER MUST NOT park in it, UNLESS an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT belonging to the DRIVER or one of the DRIVER's passengers is displayed in the windshield of the vehicle.
rules.note: 11.26 says 'windshield'; 11.16 says the permit may be displayed on the dashboard or turned-down sun visor. 11.24 states that misuse of a permit results in fines and revoked privileges.

rules.title: Reserved disability pick-up areas need a permit
rules.when: a curb area is reserved for picking up and dropping off passengers with disabilities
rules.action: stand or stop there
rules.unless: an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT belonging to the DRIVER or one of the DRIVER's passengers is displayed in the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a curb area is reserved for picking up and dropping off passengers with disabilities, the DRIVER MUST NOT stand or stop there, UNLESS an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT belonging to the DRIVER or one of the DRIVER's passengers is displayed in the vehicle.

rules.title: Permit allows parking in designated areas
rules.when: the person named on an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT is travelling in the vehicle AND the permit is displayed on the dashboard or turned-down sun visor
rules.action: park, stand or stop the vehicle in designated disabled parking, standing and stopping areas
rules.statement: WHEN the person named on an ACCESSIBLE PARKING PERMIT is travelling in the vehicle AND the permit is displayed on the dashboard or turned-down sun visor, the DRIVER MAY park, stand or stop the vehicle in designated disabled parking, standing and stopping areas.
rules.note: The permit is issued to the person, not to a specific vehicle.

rules.title: Park parallel unless signs say angle
rules.when: parking on a road where parking is allowed
rules.action: PARALLEL PARK to the curb
rules.unless: there are signs saying that vehicles should be parked at an angle
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a road where parking is allowed, the DRIVER MUST PARALLEL PARK to the curb, UNLESS there are signs saying that vehicles should be parked at an angle.

rules.title: Park on the right side
rules.when: parking on a road that is not a one-way road
rules.action: park on the right side of the road in the direction of traffic
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a road that is not a one-way road, the DRIVER MUST park on the right side of the road in the direction of traffic.
rules.note: Condition inferred from the following sentence allowing both sides on one-way roads (PARK-PAR-03).

rules.title: One-way roads: either side
rules.when: parking on a one-way road
rules.action: PARALLEL PARK on either side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a one-way road, the DRIVER MAY PARALLEL PARK on either side of the road, UNLESS there are signs saying otherwise.

rules.title: Choose a large enough space
rules.when: the DRIVER is going to PARALLEL PARK on the right-hand side of the road
rules.action: find a space about one and one-half times longer than the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is going to PARALLEL PARK on the right-hand side of the road, the DRIVER MUST find a space about one and one-half times longer than the vehicle.

rules.title: Check traffic and signal before pulling over
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to pull over to PARALLEL PARK
rules.action: check the traffic beside and behind, check the blind spot, and signal the wish to pull over and stop before slowing down
rules.unless: vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the stopping point, in which case the DRIVER waits until past those entrances before signalling
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to pull over to PARALLEL PARK, the DRIVER MUST check the traffic beside and behind, check the blind spot, and signal the wish to pull over and stop before slowing down, UNLESS vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the stopping point, in which case the DRIVER waits until past those entrances before signalling.
rules.note: Combined from the parallel parking steps and the road-test description.

rules.title: Stop alongside the vehicle ahead of the space
rules.when: the DRIVER is pulling into position to PARALLEL PARK
rules.action: drive alongside the vehicle ahead of the empty space, leaving about a metre between the vehicles, and stop when the rear bumper is in line with the other vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is pulling into position to PARALLEL PARK, the DRIVER MUST drive alongside the vehicle ahead of the empty space, leaving about a metre between the vehicles, and stop when the rear bumper is in line with the other vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: approximate; the road-test section gives at least 60 centimetres instead

rules.note: The road-test section (29.240) words this differently: leave at least 60 centimetres and stop when the vehicle is completely in front of the empty space.

rules.title: Do not reverse until the way is clear
rules.when: the DRIVER is in position to back into a parallel parking space
rules.action: start reversing
rules.unless: the DRIVER has looked all around the vehicle, checked the mirrors and both blind spots, AND the way is clear or traffic has stopped to let the DRIVER park
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in position to back into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST NOT start reversing, UNLESS the DRIVER has looked all around the vehicle, checked the mirrors and both blind spots, AND the way is clear or traffic has stopped to let the DRIVER park.

rules.title: Reversing into the space
rules.when: the DRIVER is reversing into a parallel parking space
rules.action: reverse slowly and carefully turning the steering wheel fully toward the curb, straighten the wheels when the outside rear corner of the vehicle in front can be seen, then turn the steering wheel fully toward the road to bring the vehicle in line with the curb
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is reversing into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST reverse slowly and carefully turning the steering wheel fully toward the curb, straighten the wheels when the outside rear corner of the vehicle in front can be seen, then turn the steering wheel fully toward the road to bring the vehicle in line with the curb.
rules.note: The road-test section words the steering change as 'when your vehicle is about halfway into the space'.

rules.title: Straighten and fit within the space
rules.when: the vehicle is in the parallel parking space AND is not parallel to the curb OR not within the pavement markings OR not leaving room for the vehicles in front or behind to pull out
rules.action: drive forward or backward to straighten the vehicle, fit within the pavement markings and allow room for the vehicles in front and behind to pull out
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is in the parallel parking space AND is not parallel to the curb OR not within the pavement markings OR not leaving room for the vehicles in front or behind to pull out, the DRIVER MUST drive forward or backward to straighten the vehicle, fit within the pavement markings and allow room for the vehicles in front and behind to pull out.

rules.title: Do not hit the curb or other vehicles
rules.when: the DRIVER is entering a parallel parking space
rules.action: hit the curb or touch another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is entering a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST NOT hit the curb or touch another vehicle.

rules.title: No curb: park off the travelled part
rules.when: the DRIVER PARALLEL PARKs where there is no curb
rules.action: park off the travelled part of the road
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER PARALLEL PARKs where there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST park off the travelled part of the road.

rules.title: Set parking brake and gear
rules.when: the vehicle is properly parked
rules.action: set the parking brake and move the gear selector into park, or shift into first or reverse gear if the vehicle has a manual transmission
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is properly parked, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and move the gear selector into park, or shift into first or reverse gear if the vehicle has a manual transmission.
rules.note: The road-test section (29.248) gives a variant for manual transmissions: neutral if not turning off the engine, low or reverse if turning it off.

rules.title: Facing downhill: wheels toward curb
rules.when: parking facing downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels towards the curb or right shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels towards the curb or right shoulder.
rules.note: Reason given: keeps the vehicle from rolling into traffic if the brakes disengage. Refers to Diagram 2-53 A, not given.

rules.title: Facing uphill with a curb: wheels toward road
rules.when: parking facing uphill with a curb
rules.action: turn the steering wheel to the left so the wheels are turned towards the road
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill with a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel to the left so the wheels are turned towards the road.
rules.note: Reason given: the tires catch the curb if the vehicle rolls backward. Refers to Diagram 2-53 B, not given.

rules.title: Facing uphill without a curb: wheels sharply right
rules.when: parking facing uphill without a curb
rules.action: turn the wheels sharply to the right
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill without a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels sharply to the right.
rules.note: Reason given: if the vehicle rolls it goes off the road rather than into traffic. Refers to Diagram 2-53 C, not given.

rules.title: On a hill: parking brake and gear
rules.when: parking on a hill
rules.action: set the parking brake and move the gear selector into park, or shift into first or reverse gear if the vehicle has a manual transmission
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a hill, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and move the gear selector into park, or shift into first or reverse gear if the vehicle has a manual transmission.

rules.title: Check before slowing for a roadside stop
rules.when: the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: check the mirrors and blind spot before slowing down, scan for signs to see that the stop is legal, and scan for traffic approaching from the front and rear
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors and blind spot before slowing down, scan for signs to see that the stop is legal, and scan for traffic approaching from the front and rear.
rules.note: Combined from the roadside stop steps and the road-test description.

rules.title: 150-metre gap for a roadside stop
rules.when: the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: make the stop when there is a 150-metre gap in traffic in both directions
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER SHOULD make the stop when there is a 150-metre gap in traffic in both directions.
rules.note: Worded as a description ('provides enough space to perform the move safely').

rules.title: Check right blind spot before pulling over
rules.when: the DRIVER is about to pull over for a ROADSIDE STOP AND there is a chance of traffic or pedestrians overtaking on the right
rules.action: check the right blind spot just before pulling over
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is about to pull over for a ROADSIDE STOP AND there is a chance of traffic or pedestrians overtaking on the right, the DRIVER MUST check the right blind spot just before pulling over.

rules.title: Signal before slowing
rules.when: the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: turn on the signal before slowing down
rules.unless: vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the point where the DRIVER intends to stop, in which case the DRIVER waits until past those entrances before signalling
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER intends to make a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER MUST turn on the signal before slowing down, UNLESS vehicles are waiting to enter the road from side roads or driveways between the DRIVER and the point where the DRIVER intends to stop, in which case the DRIVER waits until past those entrances before signalling.
rules.note: Reason given: so drivers will not think the DRIVER is turning before the stopping point.

rules.title: Stop parallel and close to the curb
rules.when: making a ROADSIDE STOP where there is a curb or road edge
rules.action: steer to the side of the road, steadily reducing speed, and stop parallel to the curb or edge of the road not more than about 30 centimetres away from it
rules.statement: WHEN making a ROADSIDE STOP where there is a curb or road edge, the DRIVER MUST steer to the side of the road, steadily reducing speed, and stop parallel to the curb or edge of the road not more than about 30 centimetres away from it.
rules.note: 11.47 words the distance limit as 'should not be more than about 30 centimetres'; 29.177 states it as a command. Recorded with the stronger wording.

rules.title: No curb: stop off the travelled part
rules.when: making a ROADSIDE STOP where there is no curb
rules.action: stop as far as possible off the travelled part of the road
rules.statement: WHEN making a ROADSIDE STOP where there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST stop as far as possible off the travelled part of the road.

rules.title: Do not block entrances or traffic
rules.when: making a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: stop where the vehicle will block an entrance or other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN making a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop where the vehicle will block an entrance or other traffic.
rules.note: Also stated for stopping before a three-point turn (29.272).

rules.title: Hazard lights when stopped
rules.when: the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: turn off the signal and turn on the hazard lights
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER MUST turn off the signal and turn on the hazard lights.

rules.title: Automatic transmission: park and brake
rules.when: the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP AND has an automatic transmission
rules.action: put the gear selector in park and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP AND has an automatic transmission, the DRIVER MUST put the gear selector in park and set the parking brake.

rules.title: Manual transmission: brake and gear
rules.when: the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP AND has a manual transmission
rules.action: set the parking brake and shift into neutral if not turning off the engine, or shift into low or reverse if turning off the engine
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has come to a ROADSIDE STOP AND has a manual transmission, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and shift into neutral if not turning off the engine, or shift into low or reverse if turning off the engine.

rules.title: Roadside stop on a hill: wheels against the curb
rules.when: making a ROADSIDE STOP on a hill
rules.action: set the wheels against the curb in the appropriate direction to keep the vehicle from rolling
rules.statement: WHEN making a ROADSIDE STOP on a hill, the DRIVER MUST set the wheels against the curb in the appropriate direction to keep the vehicle from rolling.

vague_terms.explanation: direction not stated here; see the hill parking rules

rules.note: The directions are given in PARK-HILL-01 to PARK-HILL-03.

rules.title: Signal and check before leaving a parked position
rules.when: the DRIVER is moving out from a parked position
rules.action: signal, check for traffic, and pull out only when it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is moving out from a parked position, the DRIVER MUST signal, check for traffic, and pull out only when it is safe to do so.

rules.title: Release brake and select gear
rules.when: the DRIVER is pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space
rules.action: release the parking brake and move the gear selector to drive or shift into first gear
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space, the DRIVER MUST release the parking brake and move the gear selector to drive or shift into first gear.
rules.note: The road-test section adds turning on the engine first.

rules.title: Flashers off, left signal on
rules.when: the DRIVER is pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP
rules.action: turn off the flashers and turn on the left-turn signal
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP, the DRIVER MUST turn off the flashers and turn on the left-turn signal.

rules.title: Check mirrors and blind spot just before pulling away
rules.when: the DRIVER is just about to pull away from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space
rules.action: check the mirrors and blind spot to make sure the way is clear of vehicles and cyclists
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is just about to pull away from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors and blind spot to make sure the way is clear of vehicles and cyclists.

rules.title: Accelerate smoothly to traffic speed
rules.when: the DRIVER has pulled out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space
rules.action: return to normal traffic speed by accelerating smoothly to blend with the traffic around the vehicle, moderately in light traffic and more quickly if needed in heavier traffic
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has pulled out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space, the DRIVER MUST return to normal traffic speed by accelerating smoothly to blend with the traffic around the vehicle, moderately in light traffic and more quickly if needed in heavier traffic.

rules.title: Cancel signal once back on the road
rules.when: the DRIVER is back on the road after pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space
rules.action: turn off the signal
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is back on the road after pulling out from a ROADSIDE STOP or parking space, the DRIVER MUST turn off the signal.

rules.title: Fog: do not stop on the road
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: stop on the travelled portion of the road
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop on the travelled portion of the road.
rules.note: Reason given: the vehicle could become the first link in a chain-reaction collision.

rules.title: Dense fog: pull off into a safe parking area
rules.when: the fog is too dense to continue OR visibility in fog is decreasing rapidly
rules.action: pull completely off the road into a safe parking area and wait for the fog to lift
rules.statement: WHEN the fog is too dense to continue OR visibility in fog is decreasing rapidly, the DRIVER MUST pull completely off the road into a safe parking area and wait for the fog to lift.
rules.note: 14.27 says 'try to position your vehicle in a safe parking area'.

rules.title: Stopped off road in fog: flashers and low beams
rules.when: the DRIVER has pulled off the road because the fog is too dense to continue
rules.action: turn on the emergency flashers and keep the low-beam headlights on
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has pulled off the road because the fog is too dense to continue, the DRIVER MUST turn on the emergency flashers and keep the low-beam headlights on.

rules.title: Whiteout: do not stop on the road
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.action: stop on the travelled portion of the road
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop on the travelled portion of the road.
rules.note: Reason given: the vehicle could become the first link in a chain-reaction collision.

rules.title: Whiteout: get off the road into a safe parking area
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND visibility is near zero OR decreasing rapidly
rules.action: try to pull off the road into a safe parking area and wait for conditions to improve
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout AND visibility is near zero OR decreasing rapidly, the DRIVER SHOULD try to pull off the road into a safe parking area and wait for conditions to improve.
rules.note: Worded as 'try to' and 'look for an opportunity', so recorded as ADVICE.

rules.title: Freeway trouble: pull over to the shoulder
rules.when: the vehicle shows the first sign of trouble on a FREEWAY
rules.action: check the mirrors, put on the hazard lights, take the foot off the gas pedal and pull over to the nearest shoulder as quickly as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle shows the first sign of trouble on a FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST check the mirrors, put on the hazard lights, take the foot off the gas pedal and pull over to the nearest shoulder as quickly as possible.
rules.note: The handbook says not to wait for the vehicle to stall on the freeway.

rules.title: Never stop in freeway driving lanes
rules.when: the vehicle has trouble on a FREEWAY
rules.action: stop in the driving lanes
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has trouble on a FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop in the driving lanes.

rules.title: Missed freeway exit: do not stop or reverse
rules.when: the DRIVER misses an exit on a FREEWAY
rules.action: stop or reverse on the FREEWAY
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER misses an exit on a FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop or reverse on the FREEWAY.
rules.note: The handbook says to take the next exit instead.

rules.title: Stuck gas pedal: stop, preferably off the road
rules.when: the gas pedal sticks AND lifting it with the foot does not work
rules.action: turn on the hazard lights, shift to neutral and stop as soon as the DRIVER safely can, preferably off the road
rules.statement: WHEN the gas pedal sticks AND lifting it with the foot does not work, the DRIVER MUST turn on the hazard lights, shift to neutral and stop as soon as the DRIVER safely can, preferably off the road.

vague_terms.term: as soon as the DRIVER safely can

rules.note: The handbook adds to turn off the ignition, not drive away, and call for help.

rules.title: Headlights fail: stop off the road
rules.when: the headlights go out AND stay out after the switch is checked
rules.action: turn on the hazard lights and bring the vehicle to a safe stop off the road
rules.statement: WHEN the headlights go out AND stay out after the switch is checked, the DRIVER MUST turn on the hazard lights and bring the vehicle to a safe stop off the road.
rules.note: The handbook notes it is dangerous and illegal to drive at night without lights.

rules.title: Tire blowout: stop off the road
rules.when: a tire blows out
rules.action: take the foot off the gas pedal, steer firmly in the intended direction and bring the vehicle to a stop off the road
rules.statement: WHEN a tire blows out, the DRIVER MUST take the foot off the gas pedal, steer firmly in the intended direction and bring the vehicle to a stop off the road.

rules.title: Minor collision: move vehicles off the road
rules.when: the DRIVER is in a collision where no one is injured AND the vehicles are drivable
rules.action: move the vehicles as far off the road as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER is in a collision where no one is injured AND the vehicles are drivable, the DRIVER MUST move the vehicles as far off the road as possible.

vague_terms.term: as far off the road as possible

rules.note: The handbook calls this 'Steer it, Clear it' and says it is especially important on busy or high-speed roads. If the vehicles cannot be moved, warning signals or flares are to be set up far enough away.
